_about: Email templates for account and usage notices. Generated from textbee-admin; do not edit by hand. The copy here is a plain fallback: the api sends the copy stored in the emailtemplates collection (an admin edit, else the base copy), and uses these fields only when the collection has neither.

footers.body:
This is a notice about your textbee account.

© {{year}} textbee.dev

templates.name: Verify email
templates.subject: Confirm your email for textbee
templates.body:
# Confirm your email address

Hi,

Confirm this address to finish setting up your textbee account.

**[Confirm email]({{verificationUrl}})**

The link works for {{linkTtl}}.

If you did not create a textbee account, you can ignore this email.

templates.name: Verification reminder
templates.subject: Confirm your email for textbee
templates.preheader: Here is a new confirmation link.
templates.body:
# Confirm your email address

Hi,

Your textbee email address is not confirmed yet. Here is a new link.

**[Confirm email]({{verificationUrl}})**

The link works for {{linkTtl}}.

If you did not create a textbee account, you can ignore this email.

templates.name: Password reset request
templates.subject: Reset your textbee password
templates.preheader: Use the link or the code.
templates.body:
# Reset your password

Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset your textbee password.

**[Reset password]({{resetUrl}})**

Or enter this code: **{{otp}}**

The link and the code work for {{linkTtl}}.

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

templates.name: Password changed
templates.subject: Your textbee password was changed
templates.body:
# Your password was changed

Hi {{firstName}},

The password on your textbee account was changed.

If you did not make this change, reply to this email.

templates.name: Close to the monthly limit
templates.subject: {{left}} messages left in your monthly allowance
templates.preheader: Your monthly allowance is almost used.
templates.body:
# Monthly allowance almost used

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages in this billing period. The allowance resets on {{resetDate}}.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: Close to the monthly limit (paid)
templates.subject: {{left}} messages left in your monthly allowance
templates.preheader: Your monthly allowance is almost used.
templates.body:
# Monthly allowance almost used

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages in this billing period. The allowance resets on {{resetDate}}.

Your plan: [app.textbee.dev]({{billingUrl}})

templates.name: Monthly limit reached
templates.subject: Monthly message limit reached
templates.preheader: New messages are rejected until the allowance resets.
templates.body:
# Monthly message limit reached

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used all {{limit}} messages in its monthly allowance. New messages are rejected until it resets on {{resetDate}}.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: Monthly limit reached (Pro)
templates.subject: Monthly message limit reached
templates.preheader: New messages are rejected until the allowance resets.
templates.body:
# Monthly message limit reached

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan used its {{limit}} messages for this billing period. New messages are rejected until it resets on {{resetDate}}.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{scaleUpgradeUrl}})

templates.name: Monthly limit reached (Scale, custom)
templates.subject: Monthly message limit reached
templates.preheader: New messages are rejected until the allowance resets.
templates.body:
# Monthly message limit reached

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan used its {{limit}} messages for this billing period. New messages are rejected until it resets on {{resetDate}}. Reply to this email if you need a bigger plan.

templates.name: Close to today's limit
templates.subject: {{left}} messages left today
templates.preheader: Your daily limit is almost used.
templates.body:
# Daily limit almost used

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages today. The daily count resets at midnight UTC.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: Today's limit reached
templates.subject: Daily message limit reached
templates.preheader: New messages are rejected until midnight UTC.
templates.body:
# Daily message limit reached

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used all {{limit}} of today's messages. New messages are rejected until midnight UTC{{#localMidnight}} ({{localMidnight}} where you are){{/localMidnight}}.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: Batch not sent
templates.subject: Your batch was not sent
templates.body:
# Your batch was not sent

Hi {{firstName}},

{{#bulkLimit}}Your batch had {{attempted}} recipients, and your plan allows up to {{bulkLimit}} per batch. Nothing was sent.{{/bulkLimit}}{{#roomLeft}}Your batch had {{attempted}} recipients, but your account has {{roomLeft}} {{roomWindow}}. Nothing was sent. You can send it after {{roomResetNote}}.{{/roomLeft}}

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: One phone on the free plan
templates.subject: Your new phone was not added
templates.preheader: Your plan's phone limit is reached.
templates.body:
# Your new phone was not added

Hi {{firstName}},

Your plan covers one active phone, and {{deviceName}} already uses it. To switch phones, turn off {{deviceName}} on the dashboard, then register the new one.

Plans: [app.textbee.dev]({{upgradeUrl}})

templates.name: All phone slots in use (paid)
templates.subject: Your new phone was not added
templates.preheader: Your plan's phone limit is reached.
templates.body:
# Your new phone was not added

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan covers {{deviceLimit}} active phones, and all of them are in use. To swap phones, turn off one you no longer use on the dashboard.

Your plan: [app.textbee.dev]({{billingUrl}})
